result: Process and EOF now share a bounded complete-frame pending-FIFO flush. Frame-aligned storage remains direct; a frame split by physical VecDeque wrap uses prepared staging. Each valid older write is counted immediately, even if a later batch has an invalid report. Current input on Err remains caller-owned; successful calls count queued, written and explicit drop-newest frames. Writer-contract faults enter FormatError until control recovery. Observed ConfigurationChanged also stays latched when another consumer clears the shared flag; explicit control validation/recovery is required. Red baseline: three-channel process left two frames stranded; later writer failure reported requested 34/written 31/queued 1 instead of owned 33/written 32/queued 1; failed new overreport request was counted despite no accepted ownership. Separate format-latch baseline resumed Ready and made two writes at an unadmitted clock after the shared flag cleared. All reproduced cases now pass. Independent FIFO/conservation reference covers 40960 events, 27360 process calls and 4640 drains across 1-16 channels, 44.1/96 kHz and five fake transport geometries (1/2/3/8/17 frames), including partial writes, backpressure, disconnect/key/config gates, recovery, reset, successful initialization/wrong-format preflight rejection and exact sample ordering. Writer calls remain bounded to two per queued flush/drain and at most three per process. Sixteen wrapped-layout callback/service/reset checks have zero allocations/frees and retain prepared capacities. Full release 79 tests pass, no ignores; strict all-target release Clippy passes with and without native hal, and native all-target check/formatting pass. Native validation is compile-only against the current dirty driver worktree; no live HAL output was opened. Queue policy, limits, telemetry version/fields, parameters and fixed target/device latency are unchanged. Recovery documentation now correctly states that pending FIFO audio is retained; reset/successful initialize count canceled pending frames as drops. Real shared-memory/device/key/restart/clock-drift/timing evidence remains outstanding; overall 35/45 complete and HAL output partial.
